name: Methimazole
description: A thionamide that inhibits thyroid peroxidase, approved for hyperthyroidism and for preparation before thyroidectomy or radioiodine.

systems.note: Inhibits thyroid peroxidase and hormone synthesis; the labelled indication.
Agranulocytosis is the characteristic labelled risk.

monitors.why: Titration parameter, though it lags the free hormones early in therapy.
Responds faster than TSH when titrating.
Agranulocytosis is the characteristic labelled risk.
